decisions.reason: This bleaching tray blank line builds directly on the firm's dental thermoforming know-how, materials capability, and existing lab channels, so early market presence suggests it can keep learning and improving it with relatively low risk.

A PETG thermoforming blank is very close to the firm's established competencies in custom dental materials and process precision, making it a strong absorptive-capacity fit that is likely worth retaining.

The UV-curing lacquer is related to the firm's materials and finishing expertise but appears more peripheral and less prominently positioned, so it has a higher pruning risk even though the firm still has the knowledge base to support it.

Custom hearing-protection earmolds closely match the firm's existing earmold manufacturing skills, hearing-care customer base, and ability to adapt products through in-house development, which supports continuation.
